responsibility: Implements the GIMPLE optimization pass that recognizes loops computing CRCs in straightforward bitwise form and replaces them with dedicated internal-function calls. It analyzes innermost loops in SSA/CFG form, traces def-use chains through PHIs and conditionals to identify the CRC state, data input, shift/xor pattern, iteration count, bit order, and polynomial, symbolically verifies the recurrence with crc-verification support, and then rewrites the loop into IFN_CRC or IFN_CRC_REV while adjusting the loop exit and result PHI.
